description.value: The Root Cellar is a much-loved Victoria institution offering farm-fresh BC produce alongside a full butcher (The Chop Shop), deli, bulk groceries, and a seasonal garden centre all under one roof at the McKenzie Corner flagship. The deli counter turns out ready-to-eat items including house-marinated rotisserie chicken and breakfast sandwiches, making it a practical stop for cyclists who need to refuel or restock. The store is known for its house-made products, strong emphasis on local BC sourcing, and notably accessible pricing.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (8 spaces) at 57m. Total: 8 spaces.
